verdict.call: qualified weak-positive: rotation is VISIBLE in the held-out structure residual but NOT load-bearing at the current error budget
verdict.summary: Adding the Maschke-Perrin R^4 design column reduces the unexplained current-weighted structure-residual fraction by a small but bootstrap-consistent amount on both arms (free-sign winner: 2-col median 0.00342 -> 3-col 0.00304, mean Delta 3.6e-4, 95% CI [3.1e-4, 3.8e-4], ~10.4% of the 2-col residual absorbed; sign-constrained: 0.00212 -> 0.00199, Delta 1.3e-4, CI [1.1e-4, 1.4e-4], ~6.1% absorbed). Both CIs exclude zero, but an extra design column mechanically lowers a least-squares residual, so the reduction alone is not evidence of rotation. The physics-discriminating tests are mixed-to-supportive: the recovered c(psi) is one-signed in its high-magnitude bins on BOTH arms (dominant-sign fraction median 1.0), exactly as the centrifugal coefficient c ~= 0.5*p0*(m_i*Omega^2/T)' demands; and |c| correlates positively with the measured CXRS line-average toroidal rotation across slices, SIGNIFICANTLY on the sign-constrained arm (Spearman 0.54, 95% CI [0.21, 0.72]) -- the very arm whose within-surface R-shape the force-balance study flagged as rotation-shaped -- but NOT significantly on the free-sign arm (0.42, CI [-0.10, 0.74], spans zero). Against the positive read: the per-slice Delta does NOT increase with rotation (high vs low stratum Delta overlap heavily and if anything low-rotation is marginally larger, on both arms), so the effect does not scale with the driver as a clean centrifugal signature should.
verdict.coverage_caveat: CXRS rotation (act) is present on only 3 of 8 held-out shots (18502, 18503, 18505; 60/160 slices). The 12xxx-campaign shots carry no CXRS and 18504's act has no time base. Every rotation-conditioned statistic (strata, Spearman) rests on those 3 shots, so bootstrap-over-shots has n_shots=3 -- the significant nonneg Spearman CI must be read with that low-shot-count caveat.
verdict.recommendation: Consistent with a real but sub-dominant centrifugal signature (~the plan's own ~15%-identifiable estimate for the ST radial span), still dominated by the coil-model remainder and the profile-ladder residual floor. Does NOT yet justify promoting c(psi) to a Tier-2 measured coefficient. The measured-rotation falsifiable test (Stage B: fix gamma(psi) from CXRS+Thomson and score held-out) should stay staged behind the coil-model remainder and needs a corpus with broader CXRS coverage than these 8 shots to power a stratified test.
